mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wstatus='待审核'),0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(wstatus='展示'),0) AS visible, COALESCE(SUM(wstatus='隐藏'),0) AS hidden, COALESCE(SUM(wstatus='已驳回'),0) AS rejected,COUNT(*) AS workCount FROM pwork
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pid) FROM waudit WHERE act='pass' AND ct >= #{start} AND ct < #{end}
SELECT c.pcid,c.pcname,COUNT(p.pid) AS count FROM pclist c LEFT JOIN pwork p ON p.pcid=c.pcid GROUP BY c.pcid,c.pcname,c.sort ORDER BY c.sort ASC,c.pcid ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pwork p LEFT JOIN pclist c ON c.pcid=p.pcid WHERE c.pcid IS NULL

SELECT p.pid,p.uid,p.wtitle,p.vurl,u.uname,c.pcname, DATE_FORMAT(p.cwtime,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS cwtime,p.wstatus FROM pwork p LEFT JOIN user u ON u.uid=p.uid LEFT JOIN pclist c ON c.pcid=p.pcid WHERE p.wstatus='待审核' ORDER BY p.cwtime DESC,p.pid ASC LIMIT 3
